name: Talondeep Pass
summary: Talondeep Pass is an artificial mountain breach carved out through heavy goblin excavation to connect southwestern Ashenvale with the crags of Stonetalon Mountains. Built over the older Talondeep Path, this passage serves as a vital transit corridor between two contested frontiers for both the Alliance and the Horde.

sections.title: A Carved Chokepoint
sections.body: Running between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains, Talondeep Pass represents goblin engineering at its most brutish. Workers blasted through the natural barrier of the Talondeep Path, opening up a direct overland link just east of Stardust Spire on the forest side, spilling out into Windshear Crag near the Fold on the Stonetalon side. The tunnel provides travelers and supply lines an alternative to traversing long, winding trails, but its tight confines make it an inherently dangerous corridor under constant threat of ambush.

sections.title: Frontier Contention
sections.body: Because the pass offers direct access to key tactical ground—including routes toward Trueshot Point for Alliance forces—control of the area has sparked fierce friction. Goblins originally tried to secure the passage with a dense minefield to deter intruders and protect their operations. Local night elves systematically disarmed the explosives, turning the excavated tunnel into an open, hotly contested thoroughfare used by scouts and warbands from both sides.

faq.answer: The pass connects southwestern Ashenvale, just east of Stardust Spire, directly with northeastern Windshear Crag and the Fold in the Stonetalon Mountains. It also features a side trail connecting to Trueshot Point.
Goblins excavated the pass using heavy mining and explosives, boring directly through the old Talondeep Path to create an easier transit route across the mountains.

faq.q: Are there landmines inside the tunnel?
faq.answer: Although the goblins originally seeded the passage with an extensive minefield to guard their interests, the night elves managed to locate and disarm all the explosives, making transit safe from sudden blasts.

faq.q: Is Talondeep Pass controlled by the Alliance or the Horde?
aliases: is talondeep pass alliance or horde
faq.answer: Neither faction holds undisputed control over the pass. It remains a neutral, contested passage utilized by both Alliance forces and Horde war parties maneuvering between the dense forests of Ashenvale and the logging operations in Stonetalon.

angles.text: The sheer stone walls and cleared minefields offer a stark look at goblin excavation methods—crude blasting powder and mechanical excavation cutting where natural passes failed.
For Alliance forces moving out of Ashenvale, this mountain breach provides a vital bypass toward strategic outposts like Trueshot Point.
